errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies four models, listing 'Physics' as one of them. The chart shows only three models in the legend (SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). 'Physics' is a benchmark category on the x-axis, not a model.
The description states that the benchmarks on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically, but they are not. The order is MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, Physics.

errors.text_span: Диаграмата съдържа четири групирани стълба за всеки бенчмарк, представляващи резултатите на всеки от четирите модела.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there are four grouped bars for each benchmark. The figure clearly shows three grouped bars for each benchmark category.

errors.text_span: За MathVista стълбовете показват резултати 75.8, 72.3, 68.2 и 60.6, докато за MathVerse резултатите са съответно 55.8, 52.9, 46.3 и 42.3. MMMU-Pro постига резултати от 39.9, 36.9, 36.9 и 53.5, а Physics постига резултати от 45.4, 46.3, 53.5 и 60.6.
errors.evidence: The entire list of numerical results is incorrect. The description hallucinates a fourth value for each benchmark category, often by taking values from other categories. For example, MathVista has only three bars (75.8, 72.3, 68.2), but the description adds a fourth value (60.6) which belongs to the Physics benchmark. The values for MMMU-Pro are almost entirely wrong, omitting the highest value (42.3) and adding values that do not belong.

errors.text_span: SRPO-7B 在 MathVista 中得分为 75.8，在 MathVerse 中得分为 72.3，在 MMMU-Pro 中得分为 68.2，在 Physics 中得分为 60.6。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the scores for SRPO-7B. It claims the score in MathVerse is 72.3 and in MMMU-Pro is 68.2. However, the chart shows the correct scores for SRPO-7B are 55.8 in MathVerse and 42.3 in MMMU-Pro. The reported values (72.3 and 68.2) are actually the scores for GRPO-7B and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B in the MathVista benchmark.

The reported values (55.8 and 46.3) are actually the scores for SRPO-7B and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B in the MathVerse benchmark.

The reported values (42.3 and 39.9) are actually the scores for SRPO-7B and GRPO-7B in the MMMU-Pro benchmark.
